svg.text: PDM MTA 0301370 — fuse side, as seen on the bike
c10 left, c1 right (the numbers are printed on the wire side), r1 top. cavity = (row − 1) × 10 + column. Generated by tools/pdm_map.py from the model.
F1 5 A → IGN_FEED F2 5 A → RH_IN F3 10 A → COIL_PWR F4 10 A → HORN_PWR F5 15 A → HEAD_SUPPLY F6 5 A → TAIL_FEED
F7 5 A → INSTR_FEED F8 7.5 A → BRK_FEED F9 10 A → FLASH_IN F10 7.5 A → USB_FEED F11 5 A → RLY_PWR
Solid dot = wired cavity, labelled with the wire name (W_ dropped). Dashed dot = cavity plug. Dashed outline = a populated spare with no wires under it.
Relay pins read 30 / 86 on the top row and 85 / 87 on the bottom, seen from this side - the diagonal rule. A -R1 relay works either way round.
